title: RL 高通电路的截止频率
statement: R = 100 Ω，L = 50 mH，输出取电感电压 U_L（o、o′ 两端开路）。电源 U_s = 10∠0° V（有效值），角频率恰好取 ω = R/L = 2000 rad/s。
求这个频率下网络函数 H(jω) = U_L/U_s 的分贝值 20lg|H|、H 的相位和 U_L 的有效值，并判断电路的滤波类型。

questions.explain: H = j/(1 + j) = 90° − 45° = +45°：高通电路在截止频率处输出超前输入 45°。
U_L = 10/√2 ≈ 7.071 V，此时 U_R 也是 7.071 V（两者相位差 90°，不能直接相加）。

questions.ask: 这个电路（输出取电感电压）属于哪一类滤波电路？
questions.explain: ω → 0 时电感短路，U_L → 0；ω → ∞ 时电感开路，U_L → U_s。所以是高通。

questions.ask: 截止频率 f_c = ?（|H| 比高频值低 3 dB 处）
questions.explain: |H| = ωL/√(R² + (ωL)²) = 1/√2 时 ωL = R，即 ω_c = R/L = 2000 rad/s，f_c = ω_c/(2π) ≈ 318.3 Hz——本题的电源频率正好是截止频率。

hints: 先写出 H(jω) = jωL/(R + jωL)，再看 ω → 0 和 ω → ∞ 时的极限。
截止频率定义为 |H| 降到最大值的 1/√2（−3 dB）处；这里最大值是 1，看 ωL 与 R 的关系。
solution: **1. 网络函数。** 分压：H(jω) = U_L/U_s = jωL/(R + jωL) = 1/(1 − jω_c/ω)，其中 ω_c = R/L = 100/0.05 = 2000 rad/s。
**2. 类型。** ω → 0：H → 0；ω → ∞：H → 1。低频被衰减、高频通过，是**高通**电路。
在 ω_c 处输出功率（∝ U_L²）只有通带的一半，所以截止频率又叫半功率点（half-power frequency）。

en.title: Cut-off frequency of an RL high-pass circuit
statement: R = 100 Ω, L = 50 mH, and the output is the inductor voltage U_L (terminals o, o′ open). The source is U_s = 10∠0° V (rms) at exactly ω = R/L = 2000 rad/s.
At this frequency find the network function H(jω) = U_L/U_s in decibels, 20lg|H|, the phase of H and the rms value of U_L, and decide what kind of filter this is.

questions.explain: H = j/(1 + j) → 90° − 45° = +45°: at its cut-off frequency a high-pass circuit's output leads the input by 45°.
U_L = 10/√2 ≈ 7.071 V; U_R is also 7.071 V (they are 90° apart, so they don't add arithmetically).

questions.ask: What kind of filter is this circuit (output across the inductor)?
questions.explain: As ω → 0 the inductor is a short and U_L → 0; as ω → ∞ it is open and U_L → U_s. So it is a high-pass filter.

questions.ask: Cut-off frequency f_c = ? (where |H| is 3 dB below its high-frequency value)
questions.explain: |H| = ωL/√(R² + (ωL)²) = 1/√2 when ωL = R, i.e. ω_c = R/L = 2000 rad/s, f_c = ω_c/(2π) ≈ 318.3 Hz — the source frequency in this problem is exactly the cut-off.

hints: Write H(jω) = jωL/(R + jωL) first, then look at the limits ω → 0 and ω → ∞.
The cut-off frequency is where |H| has dropped to 1/√2 of its maximum (−3 dB); the maximum here is 1 — compare ωL with R.
solution: **1. Network function.** Voltage divider: H(jω) = U_L/U_s = jωL/(R + jωL) = 1/(1 − jω_c/ω), with ω_c = R/L = 100/0.05 = 2000 rad/s.
**2. Type.** ω → 0: H → 0; ω → ∞: H → 1. Low frequencies are attenuated and high ones pass: a **high-pass** circuit.
**4. Output.** U_L = 0.7071 × 10 = **7.071 V**; the resistor voltage is also 7.071 V, at right angles to it: √(7.071² + 7.071²) = 10 V ✓.
At ω_c the output power (∝ U_L²) is half its pass-band value, which is why the cut-off frequency is also called the half-power frequency.
